title: Asymptotic separation of periodic orbits and fractal dimension
summary: For a totally bounded metric dynamical system $(X, d, T)$ we introduce a new critical value $\mathfrak s(X, d, T)$ which quantifies the asymptotic separation of periodic orbits.
